rules.title: Active products without a manufacturer
rules.hint: The EU product safety regulation (GPSR) asks for the manufacturer's name and address on every product page.

rules.title: Active products without an EAN
rules.hint: Marketplaces and shopping feeds reject products without a GTIN.

rules.title: Product images without alt text
rules.hint: Screen readers need an alt text; the European Accessibility Act applies to shops since June 2025.
